_meta.maintenance: Hand-written v1. Update alongside any component change; generation from source (cva/JSDoc) is planned — see docs/byb-components/monorepo-proposal.md §6/§8 Phase 5.
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable component inventory. AI agents: read this BEFORE creating any component and apply docs/DECISION-FRAMEWORK.md — every create-vs-reuse decision must cite an entry here or a decision-tree question.

fields.layer: primitive (generic UI role, semantic tokens) | byb (BYB domain/marketing component, composes primitives)
fields.description: role + when to use + when NOT to use — the reuse decision lives here
fields.variants: cva variant props and their allowed values; {} = none (extend via cva if a standard intent/state is missing — decision-tree question 2)
fields.externalDeps: third-party library powering the component. Currently bundled as regular dependencies; planned to move to optional peers behind subpath exports in the next major (proposal §4)
fields.story: Storybook source path; null = missing (gap to fix)

_meta.icons: Tabler icons are the canonical BYB icon set, exposed via the '@beforeyoubid/design-system/icons' subpath — never add @tabler/icons-react directly to a consuming app.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Vertically stacked set of expandable/collapsible sections. Use for FAQs and progressive disclosure of long content. NOT for switching between views (use Tabs) or a single expandable region (use Collapsible).

components.name: Alert
components.description: Inline callout banner for contextual status messages that sit in the page flow. Use for persistent success/warning/error/info notices. NOT for transient notifications (use Toaster/sonner) or blocking confirmations (use AlertDialog).

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: Modal confirmation dialog that interrupts the user and requires a response. Use to confirm destructive or irreversible actions. NOT for general modal content or forms (use Dialog).

components.name: AspectRatio
components.description: Constrains children (images, video, maps) to a fixed width/height ratio. Use to reserve stable space for media. NOT a general layout tool.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Person/entity picture with initials fallback, plus grouped/stacked display and status badge. Use for users, inspectors, testimonial authors. NOT for arbitrary content images (use BYBImage).

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small non-interactive label for statuses, counts, categories, and tags; includes brand-tint variants (mint/cobalt/teal/lime) for pill labels. NOT for clickable actions (use Button) or selectable filters (use Toggle/ToggleGroup).

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Hierarchical 'where am I' path navigation with separators and ellipsis collapsing. Use on deep pages (report > section). NOT for primary site navigation (use NavigationMenu).

components.name: Button
components.description: The interactive action control; supports asChild to render as a Link/anchor without losing styles. Use for every clickable action including brand CTAs (lime/navy variants). NOT for toggled state (use Toggle) or static labels (use Badge).

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Month-grid date and date-range picker (react-day-picker). Use for booking/scheduling date selection, typically inside a Popover. NOT for displaying events (it is a picker, not a schedule view).

components.name: Card
components.description: Generic bordered content container with header/content/footer slots. The default surface for grouped content — combine with token utilities for brand-coloured cards (never create a styled duplicate). NOT for pill-shaped marketing highlights (use BYBPillCard).

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Horizontally swipeable slide container with prev/next controls (embla). Use for any scrolling gallery of items. For testimonial-specific styling use BYBTestimonialCarousel, which composes this.

components.name: Chart
components.description: Token-themed Recharts wrapper (container, tooltip, legend) wired to the --chart-1…5 palette. Use for any data visualisation. NOT for simple progress/percentages (use Progress).

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Binary form control for opt-ins and multi-select lists, submitted with a form. NOT for settings that take effect immediately (use Switch).

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: A single expandable/collapsible region with a trigger. Use for 'show more' disclosure. NOT for multiple related sections (use Accordion).

components.name: Command
components.description: Searchable command palette / filterable list (cmdk), optionally in a dialog. Use for keyboard-driven search-and-pick over many items (also the base for combobox patterns). NOT for simple form selects (use Select).

components.name: ContextMenu
components.description: Right-click contextual menu. Use in app-like surfaces on rows/canvas items. NOT for button-triggered menus (use DropdownMenu).

components.name: Dialog
components.description: General-purpose modal overlay for focused tasks, forms, and detail views. NOT for destructive confirmations (use AlertDialog), side panels (Sheet), or mobile bottom sheets (Drawer).

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Touch-friendly bottom drawer with drag-to-dismiss (vaul). Use for mobile overlays. NOT for desktop side panels (use Sheet) or centered modals (Dialog).

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description: Button-triggered menu of actions/options with checkbox and radio items. Use for overflow ('…') and account menus. NOT for form value selection (use Select) or navigation panels (NavigationMenu).

components.name: HoverCard
components.description: Rich preview panel shown on hover (profile/detail peek). Desktop-only affordance — never put essential actions in it. NOT for one-line hints (use Tooltip) or click-opened panels (Popover).

components.name: Input
components.description: Bare single-line text input. Use directly only for bespoke layouts — for a labelled form field with hint/error slots, use the InputField composite instead.

components.name: InputGroup
components.description: Input with attached addons — prefix/suffix text, icons, buttons, kbd hints. Use for search boxes, currency fields, copy-to-clipboard fields. NOT needed for a plain labelled input (InputField).

components.name: InputOTP
components.description: Segmented one-time-code entry (verification codes). NOT for general short text input.

components.name: Label
components.description: Accessible form label bound to a control. Usually consumed via InputField/SelectField; use directly when composing bespoke form layouts.

components.name: Menubar
components.description: Desktop-application-style horizontal menu bar (File/Edit/View pattern). Use only in dense app shells. NOT for website navigation (use NavigationMenu).

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.description: Top-level site navigation with expanding dropdown panels (mega-menu capable). Use for website headers. NOT for in-page view switching (Tabs) or app sidebars (Sidebar).

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page-number navigation for paged lists, tables, and search results. NOT for step/wizard progress.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Click-opened, non-modal floating panel anchored to its trigger — filters, date-picker hosts, small forms. NOT hover-triggered (HoverCard/Tooltip) and NOT a menu of actions (DropdownMenu).

components.name: Progress
components.description: Determinate progress bar with track/indicator/label/value parts. Use for completion percentages and upload/processing progress. Has no intent variants yet — if a standard success/warning state is needed, extend via cva (decision-tree question 2), don't wrap or clone.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Single choice among a small set of always-visible options (2–5). NOT for long option lists (use Select) or multi-select (Checkbox).

components.name: Resizable
components.description: Draggable split-pane layout (react-resizable-panels). Use in app tooling surfaces with adjustable panels. NOT a general responsive layout mechanism.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.description: Container with styled, cross-browser-consistent scrollbars. Use for bounded scrolling regions (long lists inside panels). NOT needed for normal page scroll.

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown single-select form control. Use directly for bespoke layouts or grouped/rich options — for a labelled field with a plain options array, use the SelectField composite. NOT for searchable pick-lists (use Command) or few visible options (RadioGroup).

components.name: Separator
components.description: Thin horizontal or vertical dividing rule between content groups. Purely decorative.

components.name: Sheet
components.description: Panel that slides in from a screen edge (typically right) — detail views, edit forms, cart-style panels on desktop. NOT for mobile bottom sheets (use Drawer) or centered content (Dialog).

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Complete application sidebar system — provider, collapse/expand, grouped menus, mobile behaviour. Use for app shells (backyard-style products). NOT for marketing pages.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Animated loading placeholder shaped like the content it stands in for. Use during data fetches. NOT a progress indicator (use Progress).

components.name: Slider
components.description: Draggable track for selecting a numeric value or range (e.g. price/savings amount). NOT for exact numeric entry (pair with or use Input).

components.name: Toaster
components.description: Transient toast notifications (sonner); mount once at app root, fire with sonner's toast(). Use for async feedback (saved, sent, failed). NOT for persistent inline messages (use Alert).

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately. NOT for form fields submitted later (use Checkbox).

components.name: Table
components.description: Presentational data-table primitives (styling only — sorting/filtering logic belongs to the consumer). Use for tabular data. NOT for page layout.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switch between peer content panels in place (default, underline 'line', and 'pills' styles). Use for in-page view switching. NOT for site navigation (NavigationMenu) or sequential steps (wizard).

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text input for messages and descriptions. NOT for single-line values (use Input/InputField).

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Two-state pressed/unpressed button (e.g. bold, favourite). NOT for settings (Switch) or one-shot actions (Button).

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description: A set of Toggles acting as a segmented control — single or multiple selection. Use for view switches and filter chips. NOT for form value selection (Select/RadioGroup).

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: One-line hover/focus hint for icon buttons and truncated text. Never put essential information or actions in it. NOT for rich content (HoverCard).

components.name: BYBCounter
components.description: Animated count-up statistic for marketing stat strips — parses formatted values like '$1,200+' or '4.8' and animates to them on scroll into view. NOT for live/app data readouts.

components.name: BYBPillCard
components.description: Pill-shaped marketing highlight card — circular icon in a brand-tinted pill with text. Use for feature/benefit rows on marketing pages. NOT a general content container (use Card).

components.name: BYBTestimonialCarousel
components.description: Social-proof section: testimonial cards with 1–5 star ratings, author avatar/initials, and a brand-coloured triangle accent, in a carousel. Use for marketing testimonials. Individual BYBTestimonialCard is exported for static layouts.

components.name: BYBImage
components.description: next/image wrapper with a sensible responsive `sizes` default. Use instead of raw next/image in BYB Next.js apps for content imagery. NOT for avatars (use Avatar).

components.name: InputField
components.description: Form composite: ui/input + Label with hint and error slots and required marker. The default choice for labelled form fields (replaces legacy BYBInput). For bespoke layouts or addons, compose ui/input / InputGroup directly.

components.name: SelectField
components.description: Form composite: ui/select + Label with hint/error slots, driven by a plain options array (replaces legacy BYBSelect). For grouped or rich option content, compose ui/select directly.
